title: Databricks & the Future of the Firm
author_or_organization: Ben Horowitz and Michael McGuiness (Andreessen Horowitz, Profiles of the Future)
limitations: Investor-authored profile: a16z led Databricks’ Series A and Series C, and Ben Horowitz writes as a long-standing backer. Company metrics (revenue run rate, growth, valuation, agent-launched databases per day) and the OntoRank accuracy result (about 50% to 84.5%) are first-party or investor-reported and not independently audited. Customer vignettes (Novo Nordisk, Rivian, Block) are illustrative. Product names describe one vendor’s implementation; the organizational arguments (Coase, Simon, Burnham) are conceptual rather than empirical.
